description: Hold npm updates for the 7 days .npmrc min-release-age enforces. The shared
config's security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm rule sets 3 days for npm and, as a
packageRule, beats the top-level value; npm would then reject a 3-day-old
version in the lockfile update. @ivuorinen/** keeps the shared config's
immediate updates, matching .npmrc's min-release-age-exclude. Only update
types with a release timestamp: the preset waives the age for the others,
